title: Skill Evolver Task Fixture
description: Vertical ticket schema. Every fixture is a self-contained ticket with a source specification, a dependency graph (blocked_by), acceptance criteria, verification seams, evidence outputs, and a lifecycle status. The legacy strategy-evolution fields (skill_name, task_type, fresh_agent_strategies, allowed_paths, validation_commands, pass_criteria) remain accepted as optional properties for backward compatibility.

id.description: Stable, unique ticket identifier (may include a category prefix such as 'godot-vfx/').

description.description: What the ticket asks the agent to accomplish.

source_spec.description: Repository-relative path to the authoritative specification document (plan, contract, or design) that scopes this ticket.

blocked_by.description: IDs of tickets that must reach 'done' before this ticket can leave 'blocked'. Empty means the ticket is not gated.

acceptance_criteria.description: Observable conditions that must all hold for the ticket to be considered complete.

verification_seams.description: Commands an agent must run to prove the acceptance criteria. At least one seam is required so completion is always machine-checkable.

evidence_outputs.description: Repository-relative paths to artifacts the agent must produce or update as proof of work.

forbidden_paths.description: Path prefixes the agent must not modify while working this ticket.

skill_name.description: Optional: skill that owns this ticket (legacy strategy-evolution fixtures).

task_type.description: Optional: category label for legacy strategy-evolution fixtures.

fresh_agent_strategies.description: Optional: alternative fresh-agent strategies for legacy strategy-evolution runs.

fixed_point.description: Optional: git commit SHA anchoring the review baseline.

target.description: Optional: git commit SHA anchoring the review target.
